title: Deferred Fixed Annuities Surrender Service Terms: Release of a Full Surrender
content:
**Product:** Deferred Fixed Annuities — the Ashgrove Flexible Premium Deferred Annuity and the Ashgrove SecureRate 3, 5, 6, 7 and 10.

## Terms of release

A full surrender requested on a signed surrender request on file is released only when the owner, told the cash surrender value, confirms the surrender in person; the surrender then closes the contract and the cash surrender value is paid by the payout method the owner chooses.

| Element | Requirement or effect |
|---|---|
| Request | A signed full surrender request on file for the contract |
| Release | Only on the owner's own confirmation in person, after the owner has been told the cash surrender value |
| Effect | The contract closes as surrendered and the cash surrender value is paid |
| Payment | By the payout method the owner chooses |

## Fixing the value

The cash surrender value is not fixed until the contract carries the part-year interest credited for the surrender.

Equivalently: while the contract does not yet carry that part-year interest credit, there is no fixed cash surrender value to tell the owner.

## Owner's confirmation tool: `confirm_full_surrender_fa1c6fc8`

**Capability.** Lets the owner confirm the full surrender of the Deferred Fixed Annuities contract for the cash surrender value quoted. It closes the contract as surrendered today, records the payment of the cash surrender value by the payout method chosen, brings the contract value to zero and marks the signed surrender request as completed. Afterwards the contract shows the status surrendered with today's termination date, and its activity history shows the surrender payment.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. Unlock it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hand it over; the customer themselves — the owner — runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `fixed_contract_id` | The reference number of the contract being surrendered, as the representative reads it to the owner from the contract record | Identifier, as recorded |
| `fixed_request_id` | The reference number of the owner's signed full surrender request on file, as the representative reads it from the service request record | Identifier, as recorded |
| `cash_surrender_value` | The cash surrender value in US dollars that the representative quoted; it is recorded as paid exactly as given | A positive amount with exactly 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |
| `payout_method` | How the cash surrender value is paid | One of `check` (a paper check mailed to the address on file), `direct_deposit` (an electronic deposit to the owner's bank account), `company_transfer` (a transfer sent directly to another financial company) |

**Return.** A one-line confirmation: "Contract <contract reference> surrendered on <date>; surrender payment <entry reference> of <amount> by <payout method>; request <request reference> completed." The date is YYYY-MM-DD, the amount has 2 decimal places, and the entry reference is the surrender payment entry's reference number. Receiving this line means the contract is surrendered and the payment is recorded. No other return is defined.
